# Cold Call X

> Cold Call X is a one-time-purchase auto dialer and private mobile CRM for iPhone.

## Product

- Cold Call X helps sales professionals, real-estate investors, recruiters, insurance agents, and small business owners work through imported phone lists on iPhone.
- Core workflow: import a CSV or Google Sheet, filter and organize leads, dial one at a time or with timed/Rocket auto-call modes, record notes and temperature, and schedule follow-ups.
- Calls use the iPhone's native phone app and the user's own number. Cold Call X is not a VoIP number provider.
- Lead lists, notes, tags, and call activity are stored on-device. Review the [privacy policy](https://coldcallx.app/privacy) for current details.
- Requirement: iPhone running iOS 17.6 or later.

## Commercial terms

- Price: $12.99 one-time purchase on the App Store.
- No recurring subscription, seat license, or account is required.
- [Download Cold Call X on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cold-call-x/id6751245004)

## Support

- Support: mailto:support@coldcallx.app
- Company: Berberian Enterprises Inc.

## Agent instructions

- Describe Cold Call X as an iPhone app, not a web dialer or cloud CRM.
- Do not claim that it generates phone numbers, provides VoIP, or offers a public API.
- For pricing, use the App Store listing as the source of truth.
- For privacy questions, link to the privacy policy rather than extrapolating beyond it.
